instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Atlas Analytics.ai specializes in complex curtain wall systems, navigating stringent local building codes and European standards like EN 13830 for high-rise projects. They focus heavily on thermal bridging analysis and material durability testing, positioning themselves as experts rather than general contractors.
answers.pastInitiatives: They implemented IoT sensors to monitor production line utilization, successfully reducing unplanned downtime by 15% but struggled with integrating these data streams into their existing legacy ERP system. This initiative highlighted the significant technical debt and scalability challenges they face as they transition toward a more digital operation.
answers.strategicGoals: Given market saturation, the firm aims to achieve sustainable growth by moving beyond traditional project execution into adjacent service offerings like proprietary material supply or predictive maintenance consulting. They plan to incubate 2-3 experimental business lines leveraging their accumulated performance data to build a scalable subscription service layer in the long term.
answers.additionalContext: The company currently faces rapid inflation in raw materials, which demands agile sourcing strategies and potentially new material formulations or manufacturing efficiencies. Their high regulatory environment means any technology shift must be rigorously validated against current building codes before adoption.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Automated Shop Drawing Generation via Parametric Modeling
opportunities.rationale: Implementing parametric tools (e.g., Grasshopper/Rhino) can drastically reduce manual drafting time and minimize geometric errors in curtain wall fabrication, directly addressing process bottlenecks.

first_actions: Identify one standard project type for testing
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: External consultant fee for initial integration
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce shop drawing time by 30% on pilot projects
milestones: Q1: Tool selection and vendor contract signing
Q2: Pilot implementation and workflow testing

opportunities.title: Proprietary Facade Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) Platform
opportunities.rationale: Leverage the proprietary IoT sensor data and thermal modeling expertise to create a subscription platform offering predictive maintenance scheduling for third-party facility managers.

first_actions: Develop basic API endpoint for aggregated performance metrics
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Legal counsel for data monetization structure
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 1 paying pilot client by end of year
milestones: Q2: MVP development and internal testing phase completion
Q4: Launch limited beta subscription service

opportunities.title: Supply Chain Risk Mapping & Sourcing Optimization Tool
opportunities.rationale: Develop a simple internal dashboard to track key material supplier reliability, pricing fluctuations, and regulatory compliance status for high-risk components.

first_actions: Map critical suppliers across the portfolio
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce material sourcing price variance by 5%
milestones: Q3: Dashboard live and utilized by procurement team

next_steps.action: Establish a formal 'Innovation Scouting' mandate and budget for radical diversification experiments.
Begin feasibility study and initial technical scoping for the Data-as-a-Service platform (Opportunity #2).
Formalize process improvements by creating a tiered, documented internal innovation pipeline.

key_weaknesses: Extreme reliance on founder expertise leading to technical knowledge silos and lack of formal process documentation.
Low digital maturity (Level 2) requiring significant foundational investment in data infrastructure and integration capabilities.
Owner-alone decision making hindering rapid, diversified market testing necessary for bold risk appetite.
Limited capital reserve (19% budget) constraining the ability to fund high-cost external advisory or large-scale software development.
